answer: A farm that opens challenges speculatively across many aliases thus burns capital on every one it does not finish. Because the nebula deposit is held in the haven escrow, the vine audit records each forfeiture and the cost of a failed attempt is fixed rather than optional. Opening a challenge costs a deposit of 90 units that is returned only on a graded submission, so abandoning an attempt is a real loss. A farm of 57 pays that 75 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
